title: Pennsylvania Faces Growing Health Crisis as Measles Deaths Reach Five
subtitle: The state reports its latest death as national vaccination rates continue to fall below safe levels.

summary.en: Pennsylvania has confirmed a fifth death linked to an ongoing measles outbreak. The state has recorded 943 cases across 39 counties this year. Health officials note that none of the people who died had received a vaccine. This situation marks the worst year for measles in the United States since 1991. International experts will soon decide if the country has lost its measles-free status.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州證實出現第五起與持續中的麻疹疫情相關的死亡病例。該州今年已在三十九個郡記錄到九百四十三起病例。衛生官員指出，所有死者皆未接種疫苗。此情況標誌著美國自一九九一年以來麻疹疫情最嚴重的一年。國際專家近期將決定美國是否已失去無麻疹地位。

paragraphs.en: Pennsylvania health officials announced on Wednesday that a fifth person has died from measles. This latest death adds to a growing health crisis in the state, which is currently dealing with its worst measles outbreak in 35 years. According to the Pennsylvania Department of Health, the person who died was from Lancaster County and had not been vaccinated against the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州衛生官員週三宣布，該州出現第五起麻疹死亡病例。這起最新死亡事件加劇了該州日益嚴重的健康危機，目前該州正處於三十五年來最嚴重的麻疹疫情中。根據賓夕法尼亞州衛生部指出，死者來自蘭開斯特郡，且生前未接種過麻疹疫苗。

paragraphs.en: This recent death is part of a larger, worrying trend across the United States. MedPage Today reports that the country is experiencing its most difficult year for measles since 1991. Over the last two years, there have been eight reported deaths linked to the virus across the nation. This number is higher than the total number of deaths reported over the previous thirty years combined.
paragraphs.zh: 這起近期死亡病例是全美範圍內令人擔憂的趨勢之一。根據醫療新聞網站 MedPage Today 報導，美國正經歷自一九九一年以來麻疹疫情最艱困的一年。過去兩年內，全美累計通報了八起與該病毒相關的死亡病例，此數字已超過過去三十年死亡人數的總和。

paragraphs.en: In Pennsylvania, the situation remains serious. State officials have confirmed 943 cases of the illness across 39 different counties. The victims of the recent deaths include an 18-year-old from Mifflin County, a 40-year-old woman from Jefferson County, and two infants from Lancaster County. The state health department noted that none of these individuals were vaccinated. Regarding the infants, officials explained that they were too young to receive the vaccine under current medical recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 在賓夕法尼亞州，情況依然嚴峻。州政府官員已證實，全州三十九個郡共出現九百四十三起病例。近期死亡的受害者包括一名來自米夫林郡的十八歲青年、一名來自傑佛遜郡的四十歲女性，以及兩名來自蘭開斯特郡的嬰兒。州衛生部門指出，這些死者皆未接種疫苗。關於嬰兒的部分，官員解釋稱，依據目前的醫療建議，他們年紀太小，尚無法接種疫苗。

paragraphs.en: Measles is a highly contagious disease that can be prevented through vaccination. In the year 2000, the United States successfully stopped the spread of the virus within its borders by keeping vaccination rates high. However, those rates have dropped in recent years. To prevent outbreaks, at least 95% of the population needs to be vaccinated. Currently, coverage has fallen below this level, making it easier for the virus to spread.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹是一種傳染性極高的疾病，但可透過接種疫苗預防。二〇〇〇年時，美國曾因維持高疫苗接種率，成功阻斷了病毒在境內的傳播。然而，近年來接種率有所下降。為防止疫情爆發，人口中至少需有百分之九十五接種疫苗。目前，接種覆蓋率已低於此標準，導致病毒更容易傳播。

paragraphs.en: Experts point to several reasons for this decline in vaccination. Some parents choose to use waivers to opt out of vaccines, while others face difficulties accessing healthcare services. Additionally, there has been a rise in false information regarding the safety of vaccines. MedPage Today reports that some federal officials, including Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., have publicly questioned the safety of vaccines. These actions have created doubt among the public and have also led to the removal of funding for local programs designed to improve vaccination rates.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出疫苗接種率下降的原因有多種。部分家長選擇簽署豁免書以拒絕接種，另一些人則面臨醫療服務取得困難的問題。此外，關於疫苗安全性的錯誤資訊也在增加。MedPage Today 報導稱，包括衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.) 在內的部分聯邦官員，曾公開質疑疫苗的安全性。這些舉動在公眾間引發疑慮，並導致旨在提升疫苗接種率的地方計畫遭到削減經費。

paragraphs.en: Because of the rising number of cases, the situation has drawn international attention. In November, global health officials are scheduled to meet to discuss the status of the United States. They will determine if the country and Mexico have lost their "measles-free" status, which is a formal label given to countries where the disease is no longer considered a constant threat.
paragraphs.zh: 由於病例數不斷攀升，此情況已引起國際關注。全球衛生官員預計於十一月開會，討論美國的疫情狀況。屆時他們將決定美國與墨西哥是否已失去「無麻疹」地位，這是一項正式標籤，授予那些該疾病不再被視為持續性威脅的國家。

paragraphs.en: The public health response has been complicated by a lack of clear information. In the case of the most recent death in Lancaster County, the local coroner, Dr. Stephen Diamantoni, stated that his office did not handle the case and had not received any details from state officials. This lack of communication highlights the challenges state authorities face as they try to manage the outbreak while dealing with a complex political environment.
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生應對措施因資訊不透明而變得更加複雜。以蘭開斯特郡最近的死亡病例為例，當地驗屍官史蒂芬·迪亞曼托尼 (Stephen Diamantoni) 醫師表示，其辦公室並未處理該案件，也未從州政府官員處收到任何細節。這種溝通上的缺失凸顯了州政府在應對疫情，同時又需處理複雜政治環境時所面臨的挑戰。

paragraphs.en: As the state continues to fight the spread of the virus, the focus remains on the importance of vaccination. Health experts emphasize that the current crisis is a result of years of declining trust and reduced support for public health initiatives. With the number of cases continuing to rise, the coming months will be critical in determining whether the state and the nation can regain control over the disease and protect those who are most at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著該州持續對抗病毒擴散，焦點仍放在疫苗接種的重要性上。衛生專家強調，目前的危機是多年來公眾對公共衛生倡議的信任度下降與支持減少所導致的結果。隨著病例數持續增加，未來幾個月將是決定該州及全美能否重新控制疫情，並保護高風險族群的關鍵時期。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To choose not to participate in something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 選擇不參與、退出（某項活動或規定）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語常與法律或政策相關，指主動選擇不遵守或不參加。文中：Some parents choose to use waivers to opt out of vaccines, while others face difficulties accessing healthcare services.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The extent to which something is protected or provided for, in this case, the proportion of the population vaccinated.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於新聞報導（報導範圍）或保險（保險範圍），此處指疫苗接種的普及程度。文中：Currently, coverage has fallen below this level, making it easier for the virus to spread.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To attract or bring about a reaction or attention.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「畫畫」或「拉」，此處指引起關注。文中：Because of the rising number of cases, the situation has drawn international attention.

quiz.question: What is the vaccination status of the five individuals who have died from measles in Pennsylvania?

options.A: All five individuals had received at least one dose of the measles vaccine.
options.B: None of the individuals had been vaccinated against the disease.
options.C: Only the infants were unvaccinated, while the adults had been vaccinated.
options.D: Their vaccination status is unknown due to a lack of communication from health officials.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，衛生部門明確指出這幾位死者皆未接種疫苗（none of these individuals were vaccinated）。選項 A 與文章事實相反；選項 C 錯誤，因為文中提到嬰兒是因為年紀太小無法接種，並非只有嬰兒未接種；選項 D 雖然提到溝通問題，但那是針對地方驗屍官的資訊落差，而非死者的疫苗接種紀錄。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the United States lose its 'measles-free' status?

options.A: Because the virus has mutated into a new, more dangerous strain since 1991.
options.B: Because the government has officially stopped funding all public health initiatives.
options.C: Because national vaccination rates have fallen below the 95% threshold required to prevent outbreaks.
options.D: Because international health officials have decided that measles is no longer a threat in Mexico.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段提到，為了防止疫情爆發，疫苗接種率至少需達 95%，而目前接種率已降至該標準以下，這導致病毒更容易傳播，進而引發國際關注其「無麻疹」狀態是否會喪失。選項 A 文中未提及病毒變異；選項 B 錯誤，文中提到的是部分計畫資金被移除，非全面停止；選項 D 扭曲了文中關於國際會議將評估美墨兩國狀態的資訊。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'waivers' mean in the context of parents opting out of vaccines?

options.A: Official documents that allow people to be exempt from a requirement.
options.B: Financial penalties imposed on parents who refuse medical advice.
options.C: Educational programs designed to inform parents about vaccine risks.
options.D: Medical procedures that replace the need for traditional vaccinations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，「waivers」指的是家長用來選擇不接種疫苗的「豁免權」或「棄權證明」。選項 B 與文意相反，這是選擇不接種的權利而非懲罰；選項 C 指的是教育，與豁免權無關；選項 D 錯誤，這並非替代醫療程序，而是放棄接種的法律或行政途徑。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current measles crisis?

options.A: The crisis is primarily caused by a lack of communication between local coroners and state officials.
options.B: Measles is a minor illness that has been exaggerated by the media and federal health secretaries.
options.C: The resurgence of measles is a complex issue driven by declining vaccination rates and eroding public trust in health initiatives.
options.D: The United States has successfully eradicated measles through strict enforcement of vaccination laws.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章核心在於探討麻疹疫情復燃的原因，包括疫苗接種率下降、錯誤資訊傳播以及公眾對公共衛生倡議的信任度降低。選項 A 只是疫情應對中的一個細節問題；選項 B 明顯錯誤，文中強調這是嚴重的健康危機；選項 D 與文章事實完全相反，美國目前正處於 35 年來最嚴重的疫情中。
